# 阿里云最新Qwen4-Max大模型介绍：模型定位、特征、能力、适用场景解析

2026-11-11 77

举报

简介： 2026 年 11 月 11 日，阿里发布第四代旗舰模型Qwen4-Max预览版，首发千问 AI 平台 Token Plan，并同步接入千问办公、Qoder 等入口。该版本聚焦知识理解、世界感知、编程与 Agentic 四项升级，主打复杂编程、专业办公、前端设计与专业软件操作。预览期至 11 月 25 日 24:00，到期后模型标识下线；限时 2 折、新用户再享 5 折，最低 1 折可体验。

2026 年 11 月 11 日，阿里全新一代大模型 Qwen4-Max 预览版发布，首发渠道为千问 AI 平台的 Token Plan 订阅服务。Qwen4 模型拥有更强的世界知识和感知能力，并在编程与 Agentic（智能体任务执行）这两项最关键的能力上再度升级，能更好地完成复杂编程、专业办公、前端设计、专业软件操作等真实任务。开发者提前内测的成果显示，Qwen4 在 3D 建模、网页设计、交互等方面表现出较高完成度。本次开放的是旗舰模型 Qwen4-Max 的预览版本，模型标识为qwen4-max-preview，别名 qwen4.0-max-preview，两个 ID 均可调用。价格方面，Token Plan 用户可限时享受 2 折，新用户在此基础上再享折上 5 折，叠加后最低为原价的 1 折。千问办公、Qoder、千问 APP、QwenStudio 等产品同步接入，可第一时间体验。活动详情可参考：https://www.aliyun.com/benefit/scene/tokenplan

## 二、Qwen4-Max 的定位与版本状态

### 2.1 在千问模型矩阵中的位置

Qwen4-Max 是阿里云千问（Qwen）系列第四代的旗舰大模型，在模型矩阵中处于性能上限位置。按 2026 年 11 月上旬第三方媒体对 Qwen4 家族的梳理，该系列至少规划四款主力模型：

型号 | 定位 | 目标场景 
---|---|---
Qwen4-Max | 性能上限、旗舰档 | 复杂任务与专业场景 
Qwen4-Plus | 均衡档 | 性能、速度与成本平衡 
Qwen4-Flash | 低成本高速档 | 高频调用、成本敏感场景 
Qwen4-27B | 中等规模档 | 本地部署、数据不出域 

阿里云百炼的模型选择文档中，qwen4-max-preview 被归类的适用方向为"复杂推理与编程（Token Plan）"，并在模型选型建议中被列为"效果优先"选项，这与其旗舰定位一致。详情可通过阿里云百炼平台了解：https://www.aliyun.com/product/bailian

### 2.2 预览版属性的准确理解

按千问 AI 平台对模型版本的定义，预览版主要用于新能力验证和收集使用反馈，后续可能持续更新，与面向生产环境的稳定商用版本有所区别。

阿里云百炼 Token Plan 个人版文档给出了明确的预览窗口期：2026 年 11 月 11 日 10:00 至 11 月 25 日 24:00（UTC+8），期间不做变更，预览结束后下线。该窗口期合计 14 天 14 小时，约 350 小时。

由此可以得出四条实际结论：

- 当前的 Qwen4-Max 是限时可体验的预览版本，不是长期稳定的商用 API；
- 预览期内模型行为不做变更，这为开发者提供了一致的测试基准，是进行能力评估的有效窗口；
- 预览结束后该模型标识会下线，正式版将以新的模型名发布，接入方需要预留改配置的工作量；
- "期间不做变更"意味着预览期内不会出现静默升级，测试结果具备可复现性，这一点对严肃的能力评估尤为重要。

对生产环境而言，这意味着预览版适合用于能力评估、场景验证与提前适配，而不适合直接承载不可中断的线上业务。

### 2.3 发布路径的特殊性

Qwen4 的发布路径与行业常见做法不同。传统路径通常是"开发布会 → 开放 API → 逐步接入应用"，而 Qwen4 采用的是"预览版先进入计费平台与多类应用 → 收集真实调用反馈 → 再发正式版"。

这一节奏变化释放出两个信号：

- 模型能力先进入真实调用场景，通过实际负载与用户反馈驱动后续迭代，而非先在评测集上完成优化再对外；
- 开发者接触新旗舰模型的时间点明显提前，代价是需要接受预览版的不确定性，同时自己踩到的问题与提交的反馈会影响下一个版本。

从产业视角看，这种"先试后发"的做法把模型竞争从单点能力展示，推向"模型发布—Token 计费—应用放量—算力供给"的连续过程。对使用者的直接影响是：评估窗口前移，适配工作也需要前移。

## 三、技术规格：qwen4-max-preview

本章内容依据阿里云百炼模型文档记录整理，属二级信息源，可作为技术接入依据。

### 3.1 模态与推理能力

规格项 | 记录内容 
---|---
模型定位 | 通义千问新一代旗舰多模态模型 
上线时间 | 2026 年 11 月 11 日（预览） 
输入模态 | 文本、图像、视频 
输出模态 | 文本 
推理属性 | 推理模型，支持深度思考模式 
模型 ID | qwen4-max-preview 
别名 | qwen4.0-max-preview（两个 ID 均可调用） 

该模型融合文本生成、图片与视频理解及深度思考能力，适用于编程开发、办公、前端设计与复杂智能体任务。

需要指出一处口径差异：阿里云百炼模型清单中对qwen4-max-preview 标注的能力标签为"模型推理、文本生成、视觉理解"，未单列视频；而模型文档记录其输入模态包含视频。两处均属官方来源，处理原则是以更细粒度的模型文档为准，即确认支持视频输入，同时留意视频输入在预览期可能存在时长、分辨率或帧率上的限制，具体以调用时的接口返回为准。

### 3.2 工具调用能力

支持 Function Calling，并内置以下工具能力：

工具名称 | 能力 
---|---
web_search | 联网搜索 
web_extractor | 网页抓取 
code_interpreter | 代码解释器 

在 Token Plan 体系下，模型内置工具通过 Responses API 调用模型时自动触发，按 Credits 统一抵扣，无需单独接入。需要留意的是，在按量付费体系中，部分内置工具会在模型 Token 费用之外按调用次数另行收费；由于qwen4-max-preview 当前仅支持 Token Plan 调用，这一差异暂不适用，但正式版上线后需重新核对计费规则。

### 3.3 结构化输出

同时支持 JSON Object 与 JSON Schema 两种结构化输出格式。这一规格对工程接入有实际意义：

- JSON Object 仅约束输出为合法 JSON，字段结构由提示词控制，适合结构相对灵活的场景；
- JSON Schema 允许预先声明字段名、类型与必填项，由模型侧保证输出符合 Schema，适合下游系统直接解析、不容许字段缺失或类型漂移的生产链路。

相较仅支持 JSON Object 的模型，同时支持 JSON Schema 可以显著减少后置校验与重试逻辑，降低智能体链路的失败率。

### 3.4 API 兼容性

兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic API 协议。这意味着现有基于两套协议构建的工具与代码可以较低成本切换，包括 Claude Code、Cursor、Qwen Code、Qoder、Qoder CN、Cline、OpenClaw、Cherry Studio、Chatbox 等支持自定义 Base URL 与 API Key 的工具。

### 3.5 接入与计费限制

限制项 | 具体内容 | 工程影响 
---|---|---
计费方式 | 仅支持 Token Plan 调用，不支持按量付费或其他计费方式 | 未订阅 Token Plan 的账号无法调用；已有按量付费集成需另建链路 
服务周期 | 预览期 2026 年 11 月 11 日 10:00—11 月 25 日 24:00（UTC+8），结束后下线 | 需预留模型标识切换的改造工作量 
模型标识 | qwen4-max-preview / qwen4.0-max-preview | 建议在配置中将模型名参数化，避免硬编码 

"仅支持 Token Plan"这一条对既有架构的影响需要单独评估：Token Plan 与按量付费是两套独立体系，额度互不通用。若业务系统原本通过按量付费调用 qwen3-max，接入预览版需额外开通 Token Plan 订阅、使用其专属 API Key，并在计费与告警逻辑中区分两套体系。

## 四、模型特征

### 4.1 官方披露的四个升级方向

阿里千问团队在 2026 年 11 月 11 日的官宣中，将 Qwen4 的升级方向概括为三点表述：知识理解更深入、世界感知更立体、Coding 与 Agentic 能力持续进阶。凤凰网科技同日报道进一步归纳为四个方向：知识理解、世界感知、编程能力、智能体能力，并指出覆盖复杂编程、专业办公、前端设计和专业软件操作等任务。

### 4.2 从"问答交互"转向"完成实际任务"

这是本次升级中最具方向性的一点。据阿里方面介绍，相比传统的问答交互，Qwen4 更加注重完成实际任务，能够支持复杂代码编写、前端页面设计、专业办公及软件操作等工作。官方在预告中直接使用了"专为真实任务打造"的表述，并邀请用户"把真实难题交给 Qwen4 试试看"。

这一转向与行业评价体系的变化同向：衡量标准从"回答得多好"转向"任务完成得多好"，从单轮对话质量转向长链路执行成功率。对使用者的实际含义是，评估该模型时不应以通用问答的观感为主要依据，而应以自己业务中的完整任务链路（含工具调用、多步骤执行、结果交付）作为测试单元。

### 4.3 家族成员的第三方评测表现

在 Qwen4-Max 预览版上线前，第三方评测榜单 GameFeel Bench（一个面向游戏开发场景创造力的垂直基准，考察游戏手感、视觉呈现与创意构思）v1.4 版本中出现了两个未公开型号，业界普遍认为对应 Qwen4 的早期内测版本。据 2026 年 11 月 8 日至 10 日的多家媒体报道：

模型（榜单标识） | GameFeel Bench 得分 | 对照模型得分 | 单次任务成本 
---|---|---|---
Qwen-4-Flash-Early（代号 hawk） | 49.9 | Claude Opus 5.5 (XHigh) 47.2；Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Max) 45.0 | 约 0.40 美元 
Qwen-4-27B-Early | 44.6 | Claude Sonnet 5.5 为 45.0 | 约 0.16 美元 
Claude Opus 5.5（对照） | 47.2 | — | 约 2.60 美元 

对这组数据必须附加三点限定：其一，这是第三方垂直榜单，不是通用能力基准；其二，参评的是早期内测版本，不等于正式版或 Max 版；其三，榜单中并未出现 Qwen4-Max 的得分。因此这组数据只能说明 Qwen4 家族在游戏开发类创意任务上具备竞争力，不能用来推断 Qwen4-Max 的具体能力水平。

一个可核查的补充事实：有海外开发者公开分享，仅用一次生成、消耗 69k Tokens，就通过 Java 与 Three.js 完成了一段 3D 渲染，这与官方提到的"3D 建模、网页设计、交互"内测成果方向一致。

## 五、模型能力

以下按能力维度展开，并逐项区分官方定性表述与可验证数据。

### 5.1 知识理解与推理

官方表述：知识理解更深入。据媒体归纳，具体指向对专业文献、行业文档与复杂逻辑题的推理能力提升，长文本精读、信息溯源与复杂问题拆解更精准。

文档记录：属于推理模型，支持深度思考模式；百炼能力标签包含"模型推理"。

可验证数据：尚未公布。 官方未披露 Qwen4-Max 在 GPQA、SuperGPQA、MMLU 等知识类基准上的得分，也未给出与 Qwen3-Max 的对比数值。

代际参照：上一代 Qwen3-Max-Thinking（2026 年 1 月 26 日发布）在启用工具的 HLE（Humanity's Last Exam）评测中得分 58.3，超过 GPT-5.2-Thinking 的 45.5 与 Gemini 3 Pro 的 45.8；在 IMO 难度级别的 IMO-AnswerBench 上得分 91.5。这组数字属于 Qwen3 代际的公开成绩，不代表 Qwen4-Max 的表现。

### 5.2 世界感知与多模态

官方表述：世界感知更立体。

文档记录：输入模态支持文本、图像、视频；百炼模型清单标注"视觉理解"能力标签并标记为 New。

据媒体归纳，其优化重点包括图像、图表、截图、文档混合输入的解析，以及图表数据提取、图纸解读、图文混排文档分析。开发者内测反馈集中在 3D 建模、网页设计与交互呈现方面。

尚未公布的部分：图像分辨率与视频时长上限、多模态上下文长度、是否为原生多模态架构（区别于外挂视觉编码器）、以及视频输入在预览期的可用性范围。

### 5.3 编程能力（Coding）

这是本次升级的两个重点之一。官方表述为 Coding 能力持续进阶，凤凰网科技报道称编程能力是本次升级的重点，可支持复杂代码编写。

具体能力范围据媒体与开发者社区归纳包括：复杂工程代码生成、调试与重构，多文件项目统筹，前端交互页面与全栈项目交付，深层 bug 的定位与修复。内测成果集中体现在 3D 建模、网页设计与交互实现上。

一个可核实的落地信号：Qoder 官方宣布，此前供用户测试的匿名模型 Qoduck 已升级为 Qwen4-Max-Preview，并率先在 Qoder 上线；在此前四天的匿名测试中，Qoduck 每天都更新。此次开放覆盖 Qoder 的全部产品和全部套餐，包括 Teams 与 Enterprise。匿名测试再揭榜的做法，本身构成了对模型编程能力的一种盲测背书——用户在不知道模型身份的情况下完成了四天的真实使用，这比事后公布的跑分更接近生产环境的表现。

代际参照：上一代 Qwen3.8-Max-0902 版本（2026 年 9 月 2 日升级）在 CodeArena 前端编程总榜以 1691 分登顶，TerminalBench 得分从 11.3 提升至 29.0。Qwen4-Max 在同类榜单上的成绩官方尚未公布。

### 5.4 智能体能力（Agentic）

这是本次升级的另一个重点。官方表述为 Agentic 能力持续进阶，强调相比传统问答交互更注重完成实际任务，可支持专业办公与专业软件操作。

据媒体与开发者社区归纳，具体指向：长任务拆解、多步骤闭环执行、子智能体调度、工具调用稳定性提升、软件界面操作与跨工具串联任务。

文档记录的工具能力为 Function Calling、联网搜索、网页抓取、代码解释器，并支持 JSON Schema 结构化输出——后者对智能体链路的稳定性有直接价值，因为字段结构可被预先约束，减少解析失败。

前代技术积累：Qwen3-Max-Thinking 已引入自适应工具调用能力，可在对话中自主选择并调用内置的搜索、记忆与代码解释器功能，其训练方式是在工具使用微调后，用基于规则和基于模型的反馈在多样化任务上进一步训练。Qwen4 在此基础上强调"专业软件操作"，意味着智能体的动作空间从"调用 API 类工具"扩展到"操作图形界面软件"，任务链更长、动作类型更复杂。

## 六、适用场景

### 6.1 官方明确指向的四类任务

据 2026 年 11 月 11 日的官方表述与媒体报道，Qwen4-Max 覆盖的任务类型为：复杂编程、专业办公、前端设计、专业软件操作。平台文档同时提及，该模型适合对推理和理解能力要求更高的任务，在模型选型建议中被列为"效果优先"选项。

### 6.2 按用户角色的场景映射

用户角色 | 典型任务 | 推荐入口 
---|---|---
独立开发者 | 复杂代码项目、批量脚本、Web 全栈开发、深层 bug 修复 | Token Plan（qwen4-max-preview）+ Claude Code / Qwen Code / Cursor 
团队与企业开发 | 多文件工程联动、代码重构、自动化测试、Agent 工作流 | Qoder（含 Teams / Enterprise 套餐） 
前端与设计师 | 网页设计、交互页面实现、3D 建模、可视化呈现 | Qoder、QwenStudio 
办公人群 | 文档撰写与解读、表格处理、文献研读、方案与报告生成 | 千问办公、千问 APP 
智能体开发者 | 提示词调试、Agent 链路测试、工具调用编排、长任务自动化 | QwenStudio、Token Plan API 
企业与科研机构 | 新模型能力评估、场景验证、提前适配 | Token Plan 预览期测试 
多模态任务需求方 | 图表数据提取、图纸解读、图文混排文档分析、视频内容理解 | Token Plan API（图像与视频输入） 

### 6.3 不建议使用预览版的五类场景

基于预览版的版本属性，以下场景应保持谨慎：

- 不可中断的生产业务：预览版将于 2026 年 11 月 25 日 24:00 下线，模型标识会变更，直接上线存在改造风险。
- 对输出稳定性有强一致要求的场景：预览版定位为验证新能力与收集反馈，正式版可能调整行为。
- 需要长上下文处理的任务：上下文窗口未公布，无法评估是否满足需求。
- 需要私有化部署或开源权重的场景：是否开源尚未披露。
- 有明确合规与 SLA 要求的企业采购：应等待正式商用版本及其服务条款；同时注意当前仅支持 Token Plan 调用，不支持按量付费，无法满足以按量计费为前提的采购与结算流程。

## 七、与 Qwen3-Max 及其他模型的对比

### 7.1 千问旗舰模型的迭代脉络

模型 | 发布时间 | 参数规模 | 上下文 | 关键技术特征 | 公开成绩 
---|---|---|---|---|---
Qwen3-Max | 2025 年 9 月 24 日（云栖大会） | 超 1 万亿 | 256K | 分 Instruct 与 Thinking 两版；预训练数据 36T tokens | LMArena 文本榜预览版领先；Sup

Qwen.content:
# Qwen4-Max 预览上线：百万上下文、多模态理解与体验指南

发布日期：2026-11-11｜分类：AI与智能服务｜资料核验截至2026-11-11

Qwen4-Max 是阿里云于2026年11月11日开放限时预览的千问模型，当前接入名称为qwen4-max-preview，仅通过Token Plan提供。官方文档列出1M上下文、文本与图像及视频输入、混合思考和工具调用能力，回答以文本输出。个人开发者可以在Qwen Code等受支持工具中交互体验，但需要使用对应套餐、地域与专属Key。此次预览有明确结束时间，模型能力参数、工具默认设置和Credits计量也各有口径；判断是否适合自己的任务，应结合真实材料、可复验步骤和实际用量。

如果你最近在关注千问的下一轮更新，这次已有可核对的体验入口。Qwen4-Max已经出现在阿里云百炼的模型与工具文档中，推理、编程和视觉理解都被纳入当前预览。

不过，真正开始体验前，有几件事需要先对齐：选哪个模型名，在哪个工具里使用，以及“百万上下文”在具体任务中能解决什么问题。

## 这次上线的是限时预览，模型名要选对

Qwen4-Max当前开放的是qwen4-max-preview，预览期结束后会下线，不能直接当成长期稳定版本安排项目。

阿里云Token Plan个人版文档写明，预览从2026年11月11日10:00持续至11月25日24:00，时区为UTC+8，期间不做变更。后续是否有正式版、何时开放，需要继续看官方公告。

它还有一个别名qwen4.0-max-preview，两个ID均可调用，账单统一显示后者。因此，工具里选择前一个名字、用量记录里看到后一个名字，并不代表误切到另一款模型。

这轮更新可先用于验证真实任务，并保存提示词和结果；工具配置如果绑定了某个预览ID，也应记录结束时间，为之后更换模型留出位置。

## 百万上下文之外，这次还支持图像与视频理解

Qwen4-Max能够接收文本、图像和视频，并用文本回答，适合把材料理解与推理放在同一次任务中验证。

据2026年11月11日更新的百炼“文本生成与视觉理解”文档，qwen4-max-preview的上下文标注为1M。长材料可以围绕同一个问题组织，代码、需求、截图也能在支持相应输入的工具中配合使用。

官方参数表还列出每张图最大16M像素、单个视频最长2小时和最大2GB等边界。这些是模型服务的参数口径；客户端能上传哪些文件、怎样处理视频，还要看工具本身的支持。

同一张表中的393,216标注为“思考＋输出”共用预算，不能当成独立的最终答案额度，也不能与1M上下文相加。Qwen Code等工具还有自己的默认输出设置，不应把两层限制混为一谈。

多模态输入也不等于图片或视频生成：当前这里讨论的是理解材料、推理并输出文字。能否准确读懂图表、找出跨页冲突或理解片段顺序，仍要用自己的素材验收。

## 混合思考与工具调用，怎样转成实际任务

Qwen4-Max支持混合思考，官方文档标注默认开启思考模式，并支持Function Calling、内置工具与结构化输出。

对日常简单改写，可以检查工具是否提供非思考模式；对跨文件代码分析、约束较多的方案比较，则可以保留思考模式，观察答案是否给出能核验的依据。

Function Calling让模型提出工具调用，具体执行仍由工具或Agent完成。模型列为支持，并不代表任意客户端已经接好所有能力；应结合客户端界面、调用记录和实际返回确认。

与其只问“有没有超过其他旗舰”，不如先设定一个小任务：同样的材料、同样的限制、同样的通过标准，看看它是否减少遗漏、是否能沿着反馈完成修正。

例如可以准备一个已有失败测试的代码项目，让它先解释根因和修改范围，再逐步修复。评价时看测试结果、改动是否越界，以及你需要追加多少次提示，而非只看回答篇幅。

## 在Qwen Code中选择预览模型

个人用户可以通过Qwen Code的官方接入向导，选择阿里云Token Plan和北京地域，再指定预览模型。

按2026年11月核验的官方说明，先准备Node.js 22或以上版本，以及个人版控制台提供的套餐专属API Key。安装或更新Qwen Code后启动：
npm install -g @qwen-code/qwen-code@latest
qwen
Bash

首次启动按向导依次完成选择；已有配置的用户可先输入/auth切换认证配置：

供应商选
Alibaba ModelStudio。

计费方案选
Token Plan，地域选China (Beijing)。

在工具界面录入对应套餐专属Key。

将模型设为
qwen4-max-preview；已有会话可通过/model切换并核对当前选择。

不要保留auto后就认为已经固定使用Qwen4-Max。如果列表里没有目标模型，先升级工具，再查看官方文档中的手动添加方法；已有配置应按字段合并，不直接覆盖整个设置文件。

个人版当前只支持华北2（北京），普通百炼按量Key与套餐Key也不能混用。本文命令和向导步骤依据官方文档核对，未实际安装或更新工具、登录用户账号或进行真实模型调用。

## 第一轮体验，可以固定三类材料

Qwen4-Max的价值需要落到具体任务中，先固定材料和验收标准，比不断换问题更容易判断结果。

代码定位：提供相关文件、失败日志和预期行为，要求先列证据与修改计划，再确认修复后的测试是否通过。

图表理解：在支持图片输入的工具中附上图表，要求逐项引用可读数字；对看不清的内容明确标注，不自行补齐。

长材料核对：提供需求与会议记录，要求找出冲突条款，并标出对应原句或位置，方便人工复核。

可以从这条长材料指令开始：“先列出材料中相互冲突的要求，引用对应原句并说明冲突点；缺少证据的结论标为待确认。完成核对后，再给出需要向负责人确认的问题。”

这是一组待验证的任务设计，不是本次已经取得的模型成绩。记录是否漏项、引用能否找到、修正是否有效，再与自己现用的流程比较。

## 费用看Credits，使用范围看套餐说明

Qwen4-Max此次预览走Token Plan，不能沿用旧qwen-max模型的每百万Token单价估算费用。

截至2026年11月11日，个人版Lite的目录价为39元/月，包含20,000 Credits。这是整个套餐的月费与额度，不是Qwen4-Max专属Token包，也不等于固定请求次数。

官方说明，单次Credits随模型、Token用量、思考模式及工具调用动态变化，以控制台订阅页用量详情为准。预览期间另有计量活动，评估长期成本时应分别记录活动条件与实际消耗。

套餐月额度用尽后会抵扣可用用量包，两者都用尽时服务暂停。额度按订阅月恢复，未用完的额度不结转至下一周期。

个人版用于受支持编程和智能体工具内的交互式使用，不允许自动化脚本、自定义应用后端或非交互批量调用。体验效果不错之后，业务接入也需要另行核对可用服务与使用范围。

从百炼当前模型参数表与Token Plan说明看，这次预览把长上下文、多模态理解和工具任务放到了同一个可体验入口。先用真实材料验证结果，再核对计量和后续模型安排，本文资料截至2026年11月11日。

# GLM family

Zhipu’s GLM text models, including the GLM-5.3, GLM-5.2, GLM-5.1 and GLM-5 series and the vision model GLM-5V Turbo. They are called through the OpenAI-compatible API and also support the Anthropic-native API, so they work in Claude Code.

## Common tasks

## Models

For the full model list and live prices, see the model page , or query the Models API. The model ID prefix isz-ai/ and can be omitted.

Common model IDs (copy them exactly)

GLM-5.3
z-ai/glm-5.3Text only; 1M context
GLM-5.3 Flash
z-ai/glm-5.3-flashSupports image input
GLM-5.1
z-ai/glm-5.1Text only
GLM-5V Turbo
z-ai/glm-5v-turboSupports images and PDF 
Capability | Supported models 
---|---
Image input | GLM-5.3 Flash, GLM-5.3 FlashX, GLM-5V Turbo 
PDF input | GLM-5V Turbo 
1M context | GLM-5.3 series, GLM-5.2; the rest are 200K 

GLM models are served by Zhipu’s international site (zai); some models are also available from other providers such as Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and Volcano Engine, selected automatically by default. For how to select one, see Provider routing.

## Examples

### Python

glm_basic.py
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.ofox.ai/v1", api_key=os.environ["OFOX_API_KEY"])

resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="z-ai/glm-5.1",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain idempotency in one sentence."}],
    extra_body={"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}},
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

## Thinking mode

Key pointGLM models think by default, and complex questions can use over 10,000 thinking tokens and take several minutes. If you don’t need thinking, set the thinking type to disabled.

All GLM models think by default. Thinking volume and latency we measured on the same math problem:

Model | Default thinking tokens | Latency 
---|---|---
GLM-5.3 Flash | About 1,400 | About 20 s 
GLM-5.3 | About 3,300 | About 50 s 
GLM-5.1 | About 7,700 | About 2 min 
GLM-5 | About 24,000 | About 4.5 min 
GLM-5 Turbo | About 18,000 | About 8 min 

Passing"thinking": {"type": "disabled"} turns thinking off. In our tests it works on GLM-5.2, GLM-5.1, GLM-5, GLM-5 Turbo, GLM-5V Turbo and GLM-4.7 FlashX, and cuts latency substantially (GLM-5, for example, went from about 4.5 minutes to about 10 seconds). With the OpenAI SDK, put it in extra_body.

Thinking tokens are billed at the output rate; the count is inusage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens.

### Reading the thinking content

- In streaming responses, thinking content is indelta.reasoning_content, the same as Zhipu’s official API.
- In non-streaming responses, thinking content is inmessage.reasoning_details; concatenate the text of each item in order.

## Use in Claude Code

GLM models support the Anthropic-native API athttps://api.ofox.ai/anthropic:

Claude Code settings

ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
https://api.ofox.ai/anthropic
ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKENPaste your OfoxAI API key

ANTHROPIC_MODEL
z-ai/glm-5.3
Terminal
curl https://api.ofox.ai/anthropic/v1/messages \
  -H "x-api-key: $OFOX_API_KEY" \
  -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "z-ai/glm-5.3",
    "max_tokens": 8000,
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Explain idempotency in one sentence."}]
  }'
- On the Anthropic API, thinking content is returned asthinking blocks, and "thinking": {"type": "disabled"} also turns thinking off (on the same models as above).
- When thinking is on, set a large enoughmax_tokens and set the client timeout to 600 seconds or more.

For full Claude Code setup steps, see Claude Code setup.

## Images and PDF

Models that support image input use the standardimage_url content block; GLM-5V Turbo also accepts PDFs via a file content block:

glm_vision.py
import base64
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.ofox.ai/v1", api_key=os.environ["OFOX_API_KEY"])
img_b64 = base64.b64encode(open("photo.png", "rb").read()).decode()

resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="z-ai/glm-5v-turbo",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [
        {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/png;base64,{img_b64}"}},
        {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."},
    ]}],
    extra_body={"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}},
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
GLM-5.3, GLM-5.2, GLM-5.1, GLM-5 and GLM-5 Turbo are text-only; do not send them images.

## JSON output and tool calling

Forresponse_format, use {"type": "json_object"} and state “return JSON” and the required fields in the prompt; tool calling uses the standard tools parameter. For the syntax, see Structured output and Function calling.

## Prompt caching

GLM automatically caches repeated request prefixes, with no changes to your request. The cached amount is inusage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, and the cached portion is billed at the cache read rate.

## Common errors

Key pointSlow requests or timeouts are usually caused by thinking, which is on by default. Turn it off if you don’t need it.

HTTP · type | Error message | Cause | Fix 
---|---|---|---
400 invalid_request_error | Prompt 超长 | Input exceeds the model’s context window | Shorten the input, or switch to GLM-5.3 or GLM-5.2, which have 1M context 
404 model_not_found | Model 'z-ai/glm-9' not found | Model ID misspelled, or the zhipu/ prefix was used | The prefix is z-ai/; copy the model ID from this page 
504 gateway_timeout | The upstream service did not respond in time. | Thinking took too long and upstream did not respond in time | Turn thinking off, or use streaming 
200, empty answer or thinking content only | — | Thinking used up the output budget | Increase max_tokens, or turn thinking off 

For other general errors, see Error Handling.

## Official docs

The official docs describe behavior when calling Zhipu directly. When calling through OfoxAI, model IDs and endpoints on this page take precedence.

## FAQ

How do I write a GLM model ID?

The standard format is z-ai/glm-5.3; you can also omit the prefix and write glm-5.3. zhipu/glm-5.3 returns 404.

How do I turn off GLM thinking?

Pass "thinking": {"type": "disabled"}; with the OpenAI SDK, put it in extra_body. In our tests it works on GLM-5.2, 5.1, 5, 5 Turbo and 5V Turbo.

Why does GLM take several minutes to respond?

GLM thinks by default, and on complex questions GLM-5 and GLM-5 Turbo may think for over 10,000 tokens and take several minutes. Turn thinking off if you do not need it, or switch to GLM-5.3 Flash, which thinks less.

Can I use GLM in Claude Code?

Yes. Set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to https://api.ofox.ai/anthropic and use a GLM model ID such as z-ai/glm-5.3.

Which GLM models can understand images?

GLM-5.3 Flash, GLM-5.3 FlashX and GLM-5V Turbo support image input, and GLM-5V Turbo also supports PDF. The other GLM models are text-only.

What does the GLM error Prompt 超长 mean?

The input exceeds the model context window (the message means "prompt too long"). The GLM-5.3 series and GLM-5.2 have 1M tokens; the rest have 200K tokens.

Supporta input e output testuali con una finestra di contesto di 1M token e migliora rispetto a GLM-5.2 nella programmazione e nell'equilibrio tra prestazioni ed efficienza nell'uso dei token.

# Gemini 4 Carbon 對上 GLM-5.5：這場對決的其中一方沒有價目表

作者
Rowan Sterling
發佈日期

最新模型 · 20查看全部模型 →

基準測試：Artificial Analysis · 每日更新

返回全部文章

Gemini 4 Carbon 有定價，而 GLM-5.5 沒有定價，因為 GLM-5.5 並不存在。Z.ai 的發布日誌列出 2026 年 8 月 26 日的 GLM-5.3-Flash 與 8 月 18 日的 GLM-5.3，接著就結束了。其定價頁面最高也只列出同樣這兩款模型。在整個 GLM 系列中，沒有任何模型卡、API 識別碼、權重儲存庫或授權檔案帶有 5.5 這個數字——而且該公司自己在 8 月 31 日財報電話會議中，指出下一代基礎模型是 GLM-6.0，而非 5.4 或 5.5。因此，有用的比較不是拿 Carbon 對比一則傳聞，而是將自 2026 年 11 月 10 日起可在付費 Gemini API 上呼叫的 Gemini 4 Carbon，對上 Z.ai 實際販售的模型 GLM-5.3——再加上誠實說明：GLM-5.5 必須勝過什麼才值得重視。

## 目前存在的事物，已於 2026 年 11 月 11 日核查

「某事物不存在」的主張會逐漸失效，因此這裡提供的是方法，而不只是結論。每一行都能在一個下午內重現。

Z.ai 的發行說明位於 docs.z.ai/release-notes/new-released —— 最新一筆是 GLM-5.3-Flash，日期為 2026 年 8 月 26 日，排在 8 月 18 日的 GLM-5.3、6 月 16 日的 GLM-5.2、4 月 7 日的 GLM-5.1 與 2 月 12 日的 GLM-5 之上。沒有任何編號為 5.4 或 5.5 的項目。

• Z.ai 的定價頁面——GLM-5.3 與 GLM-5.3-Flash 位居榜首，每百萬個 token 分別為 $1.40/$4.40 與 $0.15/$0.50。頁面上並沒有 GLM-5.5 的列項可供定價。

• Artificial Analysis — 針對 GLM-5.3 的即時頁面，附有實測數據。並無 GLM-5.5 的條目。

• 我們自家的目錄——216 個模型，包括 z-ai/glm-5.3、z-ai/glm-5.3-flash以及 z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-free。沒有 GLM-5.5，因為沒有東西可提供服務。

這是四個彼此獨立的層面，而它們的說法一致。這個名稱為何持續出現在搜尋框中，是另一個問題；簡短的答案是，這件事早已被預測到：預測市場與分析師筆記曾預期 5.5 版會在 8 月與 9 月推出，但這兩個時間點都過去了，Z.ai 反而推出了 5.3 版及其 Flash 同系列產品。附在預期上的數字不是規格，而你找到的每一張含有參數數量與 GLM-5.5 基準測試列的表，都是從簡報投影片生成，而不是從模型生成。

## 真正可以執行的比較

GLM-5.3 是實力堅強的模型，也是恰當的替代對象，因為今天讀者輸入「GLM 5.5」時，最後找到的就會是它。把兩者放在相同的維度上對照，決策的輪廓便一目了然。

• 定價 — Gemini 4 Carbon 每百萬個 token 輸入 $2、輸出 $10，優惠至 2026 年 11 月 30 日，之後為 $4 與 $20。GLM-5.3 為 $1.40 與 $4.40，維持不變，快取讀取為輸入的 19%。

• 我們的收費 — Carbon 不在我們的目錄中，需透過 Google 的付費 API 存取。z-ai/glm-5.3 的標價為 每百萬 token 1.26 美元與 3.96 美元，低於 Z.ai 自家價目表，其中 z-ai/glm-5.3-flash 在吞吐量等級為 0.15 美元與 0.50 美元。

• 上下文與輸出——各提供 1,000,000 個 token 的上下文。Carbon 文件記載的輸出規模為 65K，長解碼生成最高可達 1M；GLM-5.3 的輸出上限則為 128,000。

• 輸入模態 —— Carbon 接受文字、圖像、音訊、視訊與 PDF。GLM-5.3 只接受文字並回傳文字。這是兩者之間最大的單一差距，而且差距懸殊。

• 參數 —— 根據其模型卡公布，GLM-5.3 是一個 7,530 億參數的混合專家模型，每個 token 有 400 億活躍參數。Google 未披露 Carbon 的規模或架構，而無論是 10 月 28 日的公告，還是 11 月 10 日的開放，都未有附帶任何技術報告。

• 思考控制 — GLM-5.3 的推理無法關閉；thinking.type 僅接受 enabled，effort 可設為 low、high 或 max，預設為 max。Carbon 的旋鈕提供 high、medium 與 low，其指數分數也隨之變動：60、58 和 54。

• 獨立評分 — Gemini 4 Carbon 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0.1 的高強度模式下取得 60 分，於 74 個模型中排名第四。GLM-5.3 為 32 分，排名第 43。

• 每項索引任務的成本——Carbon 為 7.76 美元，GLM-5.3 為 5.01 美元。這是唯一一個較便宜的模型同時也是較便宜任務的維度，但這還不足以改變排序。

• 速度 — Carbon 每秒輸出 79 個 token，GLM-5.3 為 66 個；首個 token 耗時 67 秒，對比為 58 秒。兩者皆為批次模型。

28 點的指數差距，是終結關於原始能力爭論的那個數字，而且應連同其注意事項一併理解。它只來自一位評測者、一套測試框架、某個指數的某一個修訂版，而 GLM-5.3 的 32 分是在其最大努力設定下測得，該設定也是其預設值。它不是廠商宣稱：這兩個數字都不是來自 Google 或 Z.ai，而且兩個模型都是依其各自的牌價而非補貼費率來衡量。

## GLM-5.3 勝在何處，而且並非毫無勝算

三個地方，全都關乎成本結構，而非能力。

首先是價格下限。透過我們，價格為 $1.26 和 $3.96，GLM-5.3 的成本是 Carbon 在 12 月 1 日之後價格的三分之一，約為 Carbon 11 月初期費率的三分之二。對於分類、擷取、路由、摘要，以及不需要前沿推理的長尾代理步驟而言，這項差異會在一條管線中不斷累積——在該管線裡，昂貴模型只被呼叫一次，而便宜模型被呼叫四十次。

第二點是價格穩定。Carbon 在 12 月 1 日價格翻倍。GLM-5.3 自八月以來一直維持 $1.40/$4.40，以此為基礎編列的預算不需要附註說明。在這樣一個季度裡，比較對象的其中一方已兩度更改存取條款、一次調整價格，可預測性就是你能放進試算表的一項功能。

第三點是權重確實存在。GLM-5.3 可依 GLM-5.3 授權條款下載。Carbon 則是付費 API，沒有權重、沒有公開的參數量，也沒有架構。對於合規態勢要求必須具備可自架路徑的團隊而言，這不是偏好問題——它會在任何基準測試被納入考量之前，就把 Carbon 從候選名單中剔除。

這些都無法在推理指標上彌補 28 分的差距。這確實意味著，誠實的建議是架構層面的，而不是選出一個贏家：Carbon 負責高難度請求，GLM-5.3 負責周邊的大量請求，並在兩者之間設置路由層，讓這樣的分工是一項策略，而不是一次重寫。

## 真正的 GLM-5.5 必須擊敗什麼

這是值得保留的部分，因為這個名字終究會成為典範，而標準已經立下了。

• 價格——$1.40/$4.40 是現行定價基準。若 5.5 以高於此的價格推出，就等於要求現有 GLM 使用者為一次版本升級多付費，而 Z.ai 歷經五代都未曾這麼做。

• 分數——現行指數上的 32 分是必須超越的數字，而真正有意義的目標並不是 33，而是 Carbon 所拿下的 60 分，因為那才是消費者在比較這兩款旗艦機時實際衡量的依據。

• 模態——純文字如今成了顯現出來的限制。Carbon 能讀取音訊、影片和 PDF；GLM-5.3 只讀文字。一個維持純文字的 5.5，在文件密集型工作上會承襲同樣的失格，無論它得分多高。

• 證據包括：可呼叫的 API 識別碼、含快取費率的公開定價、獨立的排行榜條目，以及可下載的權重，或明確說明為何沒有。GLM-5.3 四項全數通過。若後繼版本僅以研討會簡報和一項參數估計亮相，就不算通過；而最近兩次 GLM 發布都在第一天就備齊整套內容，這正是要求它們達到的標準。

隨著傳聞流傳的參數量值得用一行來說明，因為它在這一年間已從一兆漂移到 1.6 兆，再到 2.5–3.5 兆。一個沒有附帶模型卻不斷變動的數字，是估算出來的，而非實測所得，而當真正的顯示卡問世時，它會自己公布數字。
# Carbon vs the GLM line, with the dates attached
Z.ai release log and pricing page checked 11 November 2026

| 18 Aug 2026 | GLM-5.3 ships at $1.40 in / $4.40 out per million tokens, 753B total parameters, 1M context | SHIPPED |

| 26 Aug 2026 | GLM-5.3-Flash ships at $0.15 / $0.50, the native-multimodal throughput tier | SHIPPED |

| Aug - Nov 2026 | GLM-5.5 forecast repeatedly in analyst notes and prediction markets. No model card, no API identifier, no price, no weights. | NOT A MODEL |

| 10 Nov 2026 | Gemini 4 Carbon opens on the paid Gemini API at $2 / $10 until 30 November, then $4 / $20 | SHIPPED |

The next-generation name Z.ai has used in public is GLM-6.0, mentioned on its 31 August earnings call with no date attached. It skipped both 5.4 and 5.5.

## 最值得記住的一句話

如果你來這裡是想在 Gemini 4 Carbon 與 GLM-5.5 之間做選擇，那其實沒什麼好選：一個是已有公布價目表和獨立評分、正式全面推出的模型，另一個則是從未出現在自家供應商發布日誌裡的版本號。把 Carbon 拿來和 GLM-5.3 相比，決策就是能力對上成本：Carbon 在指數上領先 28 點，在價格上則落後約三分之二。兩者的每 token 成本都低到通常值得實際跑分流，而不是直接拍板——而用同一把金鑰來跑，並以 0% 加價轉嫁供應商定價，讓 Z.ai 或 Google 的價格變動當天生效，這才是等到 5.5 終於推出時也不必重寫的比較版本。

當它真的推出時，該套用的就是上面那套四部分檢驗。在那之前，任何人向你引述 GLM-5.5 的基準測試成績，引述的都只是估算值；任何人向你報出 GLM-5.5 的價格，都是憑空捏造。

Kimi.content:
Opens a sub-menu

# Kimi family

Moonshot AI’s Kimi models, including Kimi K3, K2.6, and the coding-focused K2.7 Code. Called through the OpenAI-compatible API; the Anthropic native API is also supported, so they can be used in Claude Code.

## Common tasks

## Models

For the full model list and live prices, see the models page . Model IDs have the prefixmoonshotai/, which can be omitted.

Common model IDs (copy them exactly)

Kimi K3
moonshotai/kimi-k31M context, supports image input
Kimi K2.6
moonshotai/kimi-k2.6256K context, supports image input
Kimi K2.7 Code
moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-codeFor coding
Kimi models are provided by Moonshot AI directly (moonshot), and some models also have providers such as Azure AI Foundry and Alibaba Cloud Model Studio; the provider is selected automatically by default. To specify one, see Provider routing.

## Examples

### Python

kimi_basic.py
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.ofox.ai/v1", api_key=os.environ["OFOX_API_KEY"])

resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="moonshotai/kimi-k3",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain idempotency in one sentence."}],
    extra_body={"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}},
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

## Thinking mode

Key pointKimi has thinking on by default. When you do not need it, set the thinking type to disabled (except for K2.7 Code HighSpeed).

Model | Default | Turning off thinking 
---|---|---
Kimi K3, K2.6, K2.7 Code | On | "thinking": {"type": "disabled"} 
Kimi K2.7 Code HighSpeed | On | Not supported; passing disabled returns 400 

Measured on the same math problem: Kimi K3 took about 30 seconds by default and about 3 seconds with thinking off; K2.6 used about 11,000 thinking tokens and took about 4.5 minutes by default, and about 40 seconds with thinking off. Thinking tokens are billed at the output rate, and their count is inusage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens.

Reading thinking content: in streaming responses it is indelta.reasoning_content; in non-streaming responses it is in message.reasoning_details, where you concatenate the text of each item in order.

## Web search

Addweb_search to tools on the Responses API, and the model searches on its own and attaches cited sources to its answer:

kimi_web_search.py
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.ofox.ai/v1", api_key=os.environ["OFOX_API_KEY"])

resp = client.responses.create(
    model="moonshotai/kimi-k3",
    tools=[{"type": "web_search"}],
    input="What is the latest stable version of Python?",
)
print(resp.output_text)
for item in resp.output:
    if item.type == "message":
        for part in item.content:
            for a in getattr(part, "annotations", None) or []:
                print("Source:", a.title, a.url)
- Supported by Kimi K3 and K2.6 in our tests.output contains reasoning, web_search_call, and message items in that order, and the cited sources are in the annotations of the message content.
- Searches are billed per call; for rates, see the model page .

## Use in Claude Code

Kimi models support the Anthropic native API athttps://api.ofox.ai/anthropic:

Claude Code configuration values

ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
https://api.ofox.ai/anthropic
ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKENPaste your OfoxAI API key

ANTHROPIC_MODEL
moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code
When called through the Anthropic API, thinking content is returned asthinking blocks. For the full Claude Code setup steps, see Claude Code setup.

## Image input and structured output

- Kimi K3 and K2.6 support image input using standardimage_url content blocks; see Vision for the format.
- response_format supports json_schema and json_object; tool calling uses the standard tools parameter. See Structured output for the format.
- Repeated request prefixes are cached automatically; the hit count is inusage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens.

## Common errors

HTTP · type | Error message | Cause | Fix 
---|---|---|---
400 invalid_request_error | invalid thinking: only type=enabled is allowed for this model | K2.7 Code HighSpeed does not support turning off thinking | Remove the thinking parameter, or switch to K2.7 Code 
429 rate_limit_error | Rate limit reached for the requested model. Please retry after a short delay. | Too many requests | Retry later; see Rate limits 
404 model_not_found | Model 'moonshotai/kimi-k9' not found | Model ID misspelled, or the moonshot/ prefix was used | The prefix is moonshotai/; copy the model ID from this page 
Request timeout | — | Thinking is on by default, and complex questions take longer | Turn off thinking, use streaming, or set the client timeout to 600 seconds or more 

For other general errors, see Error handling.

## Official docs

## FAQ

How do I write Kimi model IDs?

The standard form is moonshotai/kimi-k3; you can also omit the prefix and write kimi-k3. Writing moonshot/kimi-k3 returns 404.

How do I turn off thinking for Kimi?

Pass "thinking": {"type": "disabled"}; with the OpenAI SDK, put it in extra_body. K2.7 Code HighSpeed does not support turning it off, and passing it returns 400.

Can Kimi search the web?

Yes. Use the Responses API and add {"type": "web_search"} to tools; the answer will include cited sources. Supported by Kimi K3 and K2.6 in our tests.

Can Claude Code use Kimi?

Yes. Set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to https://api.ofox.ai/anthropic and set the model to moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code or moonshotai/kimi-k3.

Why is Kimi K2.6 so slow?

K2.6 has thinking on by default, and complex questions may use more than ten thousand thinking tokens and take several minutes. Turn thinking off when you do not need it, or switch to Kimi K3.

Kimi.content:
輝達 API 目錄列出 Moonshot AI 的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 多模態模型

關鍵要點

Moonshot AI 的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 列於輝達 API 目錄，發布日期為 11/04/2026，支援文字、圖像和影片輸入，可用於推理、程式設計和智慧代理工作流程。

根據輝達的文件，Kimi K3.1 Pro 的總參數量達 2.8 兆，活躍參數量為 1,040 億，並具有可進行多模態處理、長達 1,048,576 個代幣的上下文視窗。

Moonshot AI 表示，Kimi K3.1 Pro 在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 的得分為 65.7%，在 BenchCAD 中使用工具時的 Voxel IoU 為 92.7%，並在 OfficeQA Pro v2 中以最高推理強度取得 64.4 分。

Moonshot AI 的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 列於 NVIDIA 的 API 文件中，build.nvidia.com 上列出的發布日期為 11/04/2026。此模型可接收文字、圖片和影片，並生成文字，適用於推理、程式設計和代理式工作流程。NVIDIA 的列表指出，此模型可供商業或非商業用途使用，部署地區為全球。

Kimi K3.1 Pro 模型架構與輸入能力

此模型被描述為 3 兆級多模態模型，總參數量列為 2.8 × 10^12（2.8 兆），活躍參數量列為 1.04 × 10^11（1,040 億）。它採用 Transformer 架構與混合專家網路設計，詞彙表大小為 160,000，基礎模型為 Kimi K3。輸入上下文長度為 1,048,576 詞元，模型上下文視窗也為 1,048,576 詞元。另未揭露最大輸出長度。

此模型可接收文字、圖片和影片輸入。影片輸入列出的格式為 MP4 和 WebM。Moonshot 建議圖片尺寸最高為 4096 × 2160 像素，影片尺寸最高為 1920 × 1080 像素，但列表指出，這些是處理建議，而非硬性限制。

Kimi K3.1 Pro 的開發者應用情境與軟體整合

NVIDIA 的列表指出，開發者可將 Kimi K3.1 Pro 用於程式碼生成、圖片與影片理解、檢索增強生成、文件問答，以及工具輔助推理。其他列出的應用還包括 CAD 腳本撰寫和金融研究。

在軟體整合方面，列出的執行引擎為搭配 NVIDIA Dynamo 1.7.0 的 vLLM。支援的硬體微架構為 NVIDIA Blackwell，具體型號為 GB300；支援的作業系統為 Linux。列表也指出，推論測試硬體為 NVIDIA Blackwell GB300 × 8，並以 vLLM 作為加速引擎。NVIDIA 提醒，將模型整合至 AI 系統前，須使用符合特定應用情境的資料進行額外測試。

Kimi K3.1 Pro 的廠商公布基準測試結果

Moonshot AI 公布了 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的三項基準測試結果。在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 中，此模型得分為 65.7%，測試使用 Claude Code harness，任務是在資源受限的終端環境中完成具嚴格任務專屬測試的工作。在 BenchCAD 的 1,000 個檔案子集中，此模型使用工具時的 Voxel IoU 為 92.7%，未使用工具時為 72.8%，反映多視角 CAD 重建能力。在 OfficeQA Pro v2 中，此模型使用 Claude Code，得分為 64.4；整個 PDF 語料庫皆以圖片呈現，不含機器可讀文字。透過線上檢索參考答案的任務得分為零。

列表指出，除非另有說明，基準測試採用的推理力度設定為 max、temperature 為 1.0，top-p 為 0.95。分數採用相應的代理與工具設定。

Kimi K3.1 Pro 的訓練資料揭露與網路安全防護措施

列表指出，文字、圖片和影片的訓練資料規模、蒐集方式、標註方式及資料集名稱均未揭露。後訓練採用涵蓋數百個領域的聯合強化學習。開發者表示，已移除網路安全相關的中期訓練資料與強化學習任務。

Moonshot AI 表示，經訓練資料篩選後，模型利用漏洞進行攻擊的能力有所降低，但仍保有殘餘的雙重用途網路安全能力。NVIDIA 指出，使用者須對模型輸入與輸出負責，並在部署前實施防護措施及其他安全機制。

Kimi K3.1 Pro 的授權與適用條款

試用服務受 NVIDIA API 試用服務條款規範。模型的使用受 NVIDIA 開放模型協議規範。基礎模型 Kimi K3.1 Pro 受 Hugging Face 上的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 授權規範。列表也將此模型列為非 NVIDIA 所有或開發的第三方模型。

Kimi K3.1 Pro 的主要規格與基準測試資訊

說明：3 兆級多模態模型，適用於推理、程式設計和代理式工作流程

總參數量：2.8 × 10^12（2.8 兆）；活躍參數量：1.04 × 10^11（1,040 億）

基準測試條件：除非另有說明，推理力度為 max、temperature 為 1.0、top-p 為 0.95

常見問題

Kimi K3.1 Pro 的上下文視窗是多少？

NVIDIA 的列表指出，Kimi K3.1 Pro 的模型上下文視窗為 1,048,576 詞元，輸入上下文長度也列為 1,048,576 詞元。另未揭露最大輸出長度。

NVIDIA 列出的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 執行硬體與軟體為何？

列表指出，執行引擎為搭配 NVIDIA Dynamo 1.7.0 的 vLLM，支援的硬體微架構為 NVIDIA Blackwell GB300，支援的作業系統為 Linux。推論測試硬體列為 NVIDIA Blackwell GB300 × 8。

Kimi K3.1 Pro 的基準測試資料顯示了什麼？

Moonshot AI 公布的結果為：Terminal-Bench 4.0 得分 65.7%；BenchCAD 1,000 個檔案子集中，使用工具時的 Voxel IoU 為 92.7%，未使用工具時為 72.8%；OfficeQA Pro v2 得分為 64.4。列表指出，這些是廠商公布的結果，採用了相應的代理與工具設定。

# Musk calls Claude Opus 5.5 a masterpiece, says Grok 4.8 will not beat it

## AI Summary Elon Musk (일론 머스크), founder of xAI, said his company’s next AI model Grok 4.8 will not surpass Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5, calling the rival model a masterpiece. He said Grok 4.8 has finished pre-training and is undergoing reinforcement learning, with training data for supervised fine-tuning overhauled. xAI plans a limited soft rollout to some bot users later this week. Musk also said Grok 5 should exceed Opus 5.5 in 2 to 3 months.

- Writer Seung-a Yoo
- published 2026-11-11 14:11:56
- updated 2026-11-11 14:13:11

[Digital Today intern reporter Seung-a Yoo] Elon Musk (일론 머스크), founder of xAI, acknowledged that his company’s next artificial intelligence model, Grok 4.8, will not outperform Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5. He also called the rival model a "masterpiece."

On Nov. 10 (local time), IT and blockchain outlet Decrypt reported that Musk said on X, formerly Twitter, that Grok 4.8’s performance would be "not as good" as Claude Opus 5.5.

Musk said Grok 4.8 has completed pre-training and is now undergoing reinforcement learning. He added that the supervised fine-tuning data used to train AI systems to follow instructions has also been overhauled. xAI plans a limited soft rollout to some bot users as early as later this week.

Musk said Grok 4.8 is "not" at an amazing level yet, but stressed that the underlying structure was "built correctly this time." That means it will be released first to some users to check performance before the official launch.

He also disclosed an overhaul of the technology stack. xAI is discontinuing the machine-learning framework JAX and SGLang, used to run and serve AI models, and has rewritten its inference and reinforcement-learning systems from scratch in C and C++. Inference is the process by which AI generates an answer to a user’s question. Musk said the code is "a bit of C++ added to C," and added that Starlink engineers also contributed to building Grok’s training and inference systems.

Musk said the follow-up model, Grok 5, should surpass Claude Opus 5.5. He put the timing at 2 to 3 months later. He did not present specific comparison scores or a confirmed release schedule.

Anthropic unveiled Claude Opus 5.5 on Sept. 22. Anthropic said the model delivers performance close to the top-tier Fable 5.1 on most tasks while cutting operating costs by 40 percent compared with the previous Opus model for typical tasks. It focuses on complex programming and multi-step AI agent tasks.

In Anthropic’s Terminal-Bench 4.0 evaluation, Claude Opus 5.5 scored 66.4 percent. OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra scored 57.9 percent. The evaluation measures how successfully AI agents complete complex tasks in a command-line environment. Meanwhile, the model that posted a low score on the existing leaderboard was not Grok 4.8 but the earlier version, Grok 4.7. Grok 4.8’s official comparison score has not yet been released.

In the near term, the limited launch of Grok 4.8 slated for this week will be the key point to watch. Attention is on how much xAI has improved performance through its new software structure, and whether the Grok 5 that Musk has flagged can surpass Claude Opus 5.5 within 2 to 3 months.

@Dimdv99 @tetsuoai Not as good. Opus 5.5 is a masterpiece. But Grok 5 should exceed Opus 5.5 and maybe that happens in 2 or 3 months, with continued acceleration thereafter.

xAI.title: Grok API: model IDs, reasoning effort, 2M context, and errors
xAI.description: xAI’s Grok models, including the reasoning models Grok 4.7, 4.6, 4.5, and 4.3, and the non-reasoning models Grok 4.1 Fast and 4.20.
xAI.content:
Opens a sub-menu

# Grok family

xAI’s Grok models, including the reasoning models Grok 4.7, 4.6, 4.5, and 4.3, and the non-reasoning models Grok 4.1 Fast and 4.20. Called through the OpenAI-compatible API.

## Common tasks

## Models

For the full model list and live prices, see the models page . Model IDs have the prefixx-ai/, which can be omitted.

Common model IDs (copy them exactly)

Grok 4.7
x-ai/grok-4.7Reasoning model, 500K context
Grok 4.1 Fast
x-ai/grok-4.1-fastNon-reasoning, 2M context, image support 
Type | Models | Description 
---|---|---
Reasoning models | Grok 4.7, 4.6, 4.5 | Always reason and take longer; 500K context, text only 
Reasoning model | Grok 4.3 | 1M context, supports image input 
Non-reasoning models | Grok 4.1 Fast, 4.20 | Fast responses; 2M context, supports image input 

## Endpoint support

Endpoint | Supported models 
---|---
Chat Completions /v1/chat/completions | All 
Responses /v1/responses | Grok 4.3, 4.20, 4.1 Fast 
Anthropic native API | Grok 4.3 only; others return protocol_not_supported 

Grok models are provided by xAI directly (grok), and some models also have Azure AI Foundry as a provider.

## Examples

### Python

grok_basic.py
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.ofox.ai/v1", api_key=os.environ["OFOX_API_KEY"])

resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="x-ai/grok-4.7",
    reasoning_effort="low",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain idempotency in one sentence."}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
print("Reasoning tokens:", resp.usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens)

## Reasoning

Key pointGrok 4.7, 4.6, and 4.5 always reason, and complex questions may take several minutes. Use reasoning_effort: low to reduce the amount of reasoning, or switch to the non-reasoning Grok 4.1 Fast.

Model | Reasoning | reasoning_effort 
---|---|---
Grok 4.7, 4.6, 4.5 | Always reason | low significantly reduces reasoning 
Grok 4.3 | Always reasons; reasoning content is not returned | Accepted 
Grok 4.1 Fast, 4.20 | No reasoning | Returns 400 on Grok 4.1 Fast 

Measured on the same math problem: by default Grok 4.7 used about 15,000 reasoning tokens and took about 4 minutes; withreasoning_effort: "low", it used about 4,200 tokens and took about 1 minute. Reasoning tokens are billed at the output rate, and their count is in usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens; reasoning content is in delta.reasoning_content of the streaming response.

## Other features

- Image input: supported by Grok 4.3, 4.20, and 4.1 Fast, using standardimage_url content blocks; see Vision for the format.
- Structured output and tool calling:response_format supports json_schema; tool calling uses the standard tools parameter.
- Caching: repeated request prefixes are cached automatically; the hit count is inusage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens.

## Common errors

HTTP · type | Error message | Cause | Fix 
---|---|---|---
400 invalid_request_error | Contains This model does not support and reasoning | reasoning_effort was sent to the non-reasoning model Grok 4.1 Fast | Remove the parameter 
400 protocol_not_supported | Model 'x-ai/grok-4.7' does not support the 'anthropic' protocol on this platform. | The model does not support the Anthropic API | Use the OpenAI-compatible API 
400 endpoint_not_supported | Model 'x-ai/grok-4.7' does not support the /v1/responses endpoint on this platform. | The model does not support the Responses API | Use /v1/chat/completions 
404 model_not_found | Model 'xai/grok-4.7' not found | The prefix was written as xai/ | The prefix is x-ai/ 
Request timeout | — | Reasoning takes too long | Pass reasoning_effort: "low", use streaming, or set the client timeout to 600 seconds or more 

For other general errors, see Error handling.

## Official docs

## FAQ

How do I write Grok model IDs?

The standard form is x-ai/grok-4.7; you can also omit the prefix and write grok-4.7. Writing xai/grok-4.7 returns 404.

Why is Grok 4.7 so slow?

Grok 4.7, 4.6, and 4.5 always reason, and complex questions may use more than ten thousand reasoning tokens and take several minutes. Passing reasoning_effort: "low" shortens this significantly, or switch to the non-reasoning Grok 4.1 Fast.

Can reasoning be turned off for Grok?

Reasoning cannot be turned off for Grok 4.7, 4.6, 4.5, or 4.3; you can only reduce it with reasoning_effort. For fast responses, use Grok 4.1 Fast.

Can Claude Code use Grok?

Only Grok 4.3 supports the Anthropic API; calls to other Grok models return protocol_not_supported.

How long a context does Grok support?

Grok 4.1 Fast and 4.20 support 2M tokens, Grok 4.3 supports 1M, and Grok 4.7, 4.6, and 4.5 support 500K.

xAI.title: Overview
xAI.description: xAI is an OpenAI-compatible provider powering the Grok family of models. Bifrost delegates to the OpenAI implementation with standard parameter filtering. Key features: - Full OpenAI compatibility - Chat ... and responses - Vision support - Image URLs and base64 encoding for multimodal models ... - Reasoning support - Extended thinking for Grok reasoning models
xAI.content:
## Overview

xAI is an OpenAI-compatible provider powering the Grok family of models. Bifrost delegates to the OpenAI implementation with standard parameter filtering. Key features:

- Full OpenAI compatibility - Chat, text completion, and responses
- Vision support - Image URLs and base64 encoding for multimodal models
- Streaming support - Server-Sent Events with delta-based updates
- Reasoning support - Extended thinking for Grok reasoning models
- Tool calling - Complete function definition and execution
- Parameter filtering - Removes unsupported OpenAI-specific fields

### Supported Operations

Operation | Non-Streaming | Streaming | Endpoint 
---|---|---|---
Chat Completions | ✅ | ✅ | /v1/chat/completions 
Responses API | ✅ | ✅ | /v1/responses 
Text Completions | ✅ | ✅ | /v1/completions 
Image Generation | ✅ | - | /v1/images/generations 
Context Compaction | ✅ | - | /v1/responses/compact 
List Models | ✅ | - | /v1/models 
Embeddings | ❌ | ❌ | - 
Speech (TTS) | ❌ | ❌ | - 
Transcriptions (STT) | ❌ | ❌ | - 
Files | ❌ | ❌ | - 
Batch | ❌ | ❌ | - 

Unsupported Operations (❌): Embeddings, Speech, Transcriptions, Files, and Batch are not supported by the upstream xAI API. These returnUnsupportedOperationError.

## Setup & Configuration

Configure xAI as a provider.

### Web UI

- Navigate to Models > Model Providers. Look for xAI under Configured Providers. If it is missing, click on Add New Provider and select xAI.
- Click Add Key or edit an existing key.
- Set a name for your key.
- Paste your API key directly or use an environment variable (for example,env.XAI_API_KEY).
- Set Allowed Models to All Models (default) or the specific model allowlist you want this key to serve.
- Save the provider configuration.

### config.json
{
  "providers": {
    "xai": {
      "keys": [
        {
          "name": "xai-key-1",
          "value": "env.XAI_API_KEY",
          "models": [
            "*"
          ],
          "weight": 1.0
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}

### API

Refer to the API documentation for Provider Keys Management.

### Go SDK
case schemas.XAI:
    return []schemas.Key{{
        Name:   "xai-key-1",
        Value:  *schemas.NewSecretVar("env.XAI_API_KEY"),
        Models: []string{"*"},
        Weight: 1.0,
    }}, nil

# 1. Chat Completions

## Request Parameters

xAI supports all standard OpenAI chat completion parameters. For full parameter reference and behavior, see OpenAI Chat Completions.

### Filtered Parameters

Removed for xAI compatibility:

- prompt_cache_key - Not supported
- verbosity - Anthropic-specific
- store - Not supported
- service_tier - Not supported

### Reasoning Support

xAI'sgrok-3-mini model supports extended reasoning via the standard reasoning_effort field:
{
  "model": "xai/grok-3-mini",
  "messages": [...],
  "reasoning_effort": "high"
}

Model-Specific Feature: Thereasoning_effort parameter is only supported by grok-3-mini. Other Grok-3 and Grok-4 models will return an error if this parameter is specified.

Bifrost converts from the internalReasoning structure to xAI's reasoning_effort string format.

### Vision Support

xAI vision models support both image URLs and base64-encoded images:
{
  "model": "xai/grok-2-vision-1212",
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": [
      {"type": "text", "text": "What is in this image?"},
      {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "https://..."}}
    ]
  }]
}

Supported Image Formats:

- ✅ Image URLs
- ✅ Base64-encoded images
- ✅ Multiple images per message

xAI supports all standard OpenAI message types, tools, responses, and streaming formats. For details on message handling, tool conversion, responses, and streaming, refer to OpenAI Chat Completions.

# 2. Responses API

xAI's Responses API is forwarded directly to/v1/responses:
ResponsesRequest → /v1/responses → ResponsesResponse

Same parameter support and message handling as Chat Completions. Full streaming support available.

# 3. Text Completions

xAI supports legacy text completion format:

Parameter | Mapping 
---|---
prompt | Direct pass-through 
max_tokens | max_tokens 
temperature, top_p | Direct pass-through 
stop | Stop sequences 
frequency_penalty, presence_penalty | Penalty parameters 

Streaming support available viastream: true.

# 4. Image Generation

xAI's image generation uses the OpenAI-compatible format.

Request Conversion

xAI uses the same conversion as OpenAI (see OpenAI Image Generation):

- Model & Prompt:bifrostReq.Model → req.Model, bifrostReq.Prompt → req.Prompt
- Parameters: All fields frombifrostReq (ImageGenerationParameters) are embedded directly into the request struct via struct embedding
- Endpoint:/v1/images/generations

Note :quality, size and style parameters are not supported by xAI's API at the moment.

Response Conversion

Responses are unmarshaled directly intoBifrostImageGenerationResponse.

Streaming: Image generation streaming is not supported by xAI.

# 5. List Models

Lists available xAI models with their capabilities and context lengths.

# 6. Context Compaction

xAI supports context compaction via its OpenAI-compatible/v1/responses/compact endpoint. Bifrost forwards the request to https://api.x.ai/v1/responses/compact.

Request and response format is identical to OpenAI Context Compaction. The responseoutput contains the original user messages plus a final item with type: "response.compaction" and encrypted_content. Pass this output as input to future xAI Responses API calls.

Endpoint:POST /v1/responses/compact

## Unsupported Features

Feature | Reason 
---|---
Embedding | Not offered by xAI API 
Speech/TTS | Not offered by xAI API 
Transcription/STT | Not offered by xAI API 
Batch Operations | Not offered by xAI API 
File Management | Not offered by xAI API

xAI.description: grok workers run the official xAI Grok CLI (@xai-official/grok, pinned to 1.0.77) as an Agent Client Protocol server: grok agent --no-leader stdio. ... With anXAI_API_KEY, grok models lists xAI's text models...
xAI.content:
# Grok

grok workers run the official xAI Grok CLI (@xai-official/grok, pinned to 1.0.77) as an Agent Client Protocol server: grok agent --no-leader stdio. The agent loop and tools run inside the worker. Inference runs on xAI's API with XAI_API_KEY, or on OpenRouter with OPENROUTER_API_KEY for an openrouter/<id> model.

For the adapter internals, see Harness Providers.

## Create the API key

Create a key in the xAI console. API usage is billed to the team that owns the key, so set a spending limit there for a shared swarm.

A SuperGrok subscription login (grok login) is not supported yet. The swarm uses API-key billing only.

## Configure the worker
# .env.docker
HARNESS_PROVIDER=grok
XAI_API_KEY=xai-...

You can also storeXAI_API_KEY as a swarm secret instead of the worker environment. A worker with neither XAI_API_KEY nor OPENROUTER_API_KEY waits until one appears in the swarm config. The dashboard's Test connection checks the xAI key with GET https://api.x.ai/v1/models, the call the CLI makes first, which runs no model. With only OPENROUTER_API_KEY set, it checks OpenRouter's /models.

The full worker image (worker-full) installs the CLI at /usr/local/bin/grok. The slim image has none: the runner fails an affected task with installation guidance when the executable is absent. GROK_BINARY selects another trusted executable.

A rejected key surfaces asGrok rejected the credentials (XAI_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY invalid or missing). The CLI's own message for a bad key is "Not signed in", which points at the wrong fix.

## Models

With anXAI_API_KEY, grok models lists xAI's text models: grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-4.5, grok-4.3, grok-4.20-0309-reasoning, grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning (the CLI default) and grok-build-0.1. The picker shows all of them. It leaves out grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309, which takes no client tools, and the image and video models. A custom model id still works. A grok worker refuses another vendor's model (claude-opus-5-5, openai/gpt-5.6-sol, latest:anthropic/opus) at task creation and claim: those run only as openrouter/<vendor>/<id>.

Tier | Model | Per 1M tokens (input / cache read / output) 
---|---|---
smol | grok-build-0.1 | $1.00 / $0.20 / $2.00 
regular | grok-4.3 | $1.25 / $0.20 / $2.50 
smart | grok-4.6 | $2.00 / $0.50 / $6.00 
ultra | grok-4.7 | $2.00 / $0.50 / $6.00 

Reasoning effort goes to the CLI's--reasoning-effort flag. grok-4.6 takes low, medium, high and xhigh.

### OpenRouter models

The Grok CLI runs any OpenAI-compatible model registered under[model.<id>] in its config.toml. Pick a model as openrouter/<vendor>/<id> (for example openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash), and the adapter writes this block into the session's GROK_HOME:
[model."openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash"]
model = "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash"
base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"   # OPENROUTER_BASE_URL when set
env_key = "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
api_backend = "chat_completions"

An OpenRouter session getsOPENROUTER_API_KEY and never XAI_API_KEY, so no xAI side model (web search, summaries) bills the xAI key. The picker lists the OpenRouter catalog behind OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

### Custom endpoints

The CLI's own endpoint variables pass through on the xAI route, authenticated withXAI_API_KEY:

Variable | Effect 
---|---
GROK_MODELS_BASE_URL | Sends inference and the model list ({base}/models) to another OpenAI-compatible endpoint 
GROK_MODELS_LIST_URL | Overrides the model-list URL 
GROK_XAI_API_BASE_URL | Overrides the xAI API base (default https://api.x.ai/v1) 

See the Grok CLI settings reference.

## Isolation

Each session gets a freshGROK_HOME, removed when the session ends, so no login, session or leader socket is shared between tasks. Inside it the adapter:

- turns off the CLI's Claude Code and Cursor compatibility for hooks, MCP servers,CLAUDE.md and rules, so the worker's own Claude setup does not load into Grok;
- disables the worker's Claude Code plugins by name and pinsallow_managed_hooks_only, so no plugin or compat hook fires;
- keeps Claude skills on, so the swarm's skills stay available;
- turns off the auto-updater and telemetry.

The swarm prompt is appended to Grok's own system prompt (session/new _meta.rules), and every tool call is auto-approved.

## Cost

Grok answers each prompt without an ACPusage and puts the prompt's cumulative usage in _meta.usage: tokens, model calls and costUsdTicks, what xAI billed in units of 1e-10 USD. The adapter converts it to the swarm's shape: input without cache reads, output with reasoning tokens, and the billed USD. _meta.modelId names the model that ran, and _meta.usage.modelUsage splits the usage per model, so a side model or fallback gets its own row in the breakdown. The API keeps that USD as the row's cost (costSource: harness), long-context rates included, and prices the per-model breakdown from the grok pricing rows (models.dev xAI rates).

An OpenRouter model reports tokens but no USD, so the API prices it from the OpenRouter rates (costSource: pricing-table). See Cost and context computation.

## Limits

- No live steering. Grok exposes no steer primitive, so the worker advertises no steer modes.
- No session resume.
- No SuperGrok OAuth pool yet.

cross_cutting.content:
## LLMs

本章节收录主流大语言模型。先是 2024–2026 年最具影响力的旗舰、开源与国产模型，随后保留早期经典开源 LLM 供学习参考。

### 2024–2026 主流大模型

时间与版本截至 2026 年 8 月，模型迭代极快，请以官方渠道为准。

#### 国外闭源旗舰模型

模型 | 开发方 | 链接 | 中文简介（关键能力与发布时间） 
---|---|---|---
GPT-5.6（Luna / Terra / Sol） | OpenAI | openai.com | 2026 年 7 月 9 日发布的三档模型家族（由弱到强 Luna / Terra / Sol），面向企业工作、编码、科研与网络安全；Sol 为最强档，8 月 21 日起 API 降价 20%+。 
GPT-5 | OpenAI | openai.com | 2025 年 8 月发布，OpenAI 新一代旗舰，统一推理与对话（自动调度"思考"模式），取代 GPT-4o/o3 成为 ChatGPT 默认模型。 
o3 / o4-mini | OpenAI | openai.com | 2025 年 4 月发布的 o 系列推理模型，"先思考后回答"，o4-mini 主打高性价比快速推理。 
GPT-4.1 | OpenAI | openai.com | 2025 年 4 月发布，专精编码，100 万 token 长上下文，指令遵循强。 
Claude 5 家族（Fable 5 / Opus 5 / Sonnet 5） | Anthropic | platform.claude.com | 2026 年 6–7 月发布的第 5 代：Fable 5（6 月 9 日，Mythos 级旗舰，$10/$50 每百万 token）、Sonnet 5（6 月 30 日，$2/$10）、Opus 5（7 月 24 日，$5/$25，接近 Fable 5 智能但价格减半）；三者均 1M 上下文、128K 输出、自适应思考。 
Claude Opus 4.5 | Anthropic | anthropic.com | 2025 年 11 月发布，Anthropic 最强模型，编码与智能体能力顶尖。 
Claude Sonnet 4.5 | Anthropic | anthropic.com | 2025 年 9 月发布，平衡性能与成本，长程智能体任务表现优异。 
Claude 4（Opus 4 / Sonnet 4） | Anthropic | anthropic.com | 2025 年 5 月发布的第 4 代，Opus 4 号称"世界最佳编码模型"。 
Gemini 3.x（3.7 Flash / 3.5 Flash / 3.1 Pro） | Google DeepMind | changelog | 2026 年迭代：3.5 Flash（5 月 GA）、3.6 Flash（7 月）、3.7 Flash（8 月 13 日 GA，「最智能的编码 / Agent 主力模型」）；3.1 Pro 仍为预览。另有 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 视频生成模型（8 月 GA）。 
Gemini 3 Pro | Google DeepMind | blog.google | 2025 年 11 月发布，Google 最强多模态旗舰，"推理优先"，含 Deep Think 模式。 
Gemini 2.5 Pro / Flash | Google DeepMind | developers.googleblog.com | "思考型"系列，Pro 主打高智能、Flash 主打低延迟低成本。 
Grok 4 | xAI | x.ai | 2025 年 7 月发布，256K 上下文，原生工具调用（代码、联网与 X 搜索）。 

#### 国外开源 / 开放权重模型

模型 | 开发方 | 链接 | 中文简介（关键能力与发布时间） 
---|---|---|---
Llama 4（Scout / Maverick） | Meta | ai.meta.com | 2025 年 4 月发布，原生多模态 MoE，Scout 上下文达 10M，Maverick 多模态超 GPT-4o。 
Llama 3.3 70B | Meta | llama.com | 2024 年 12 月发布，70B 性能对标 3.1 的 405B，推理成本大幅降低。 
Mistral Large 3 | Mistral AI | mistral.ai | 2025 年 12 月发布，稀疏 MoE，41B 激活 / 675B 总参，开放权重前沿模型。 
Gemma 3 | ai.google.dev | Google 开源小模型系列，基于 Gemini 技术，可单卡运行、多模态。 

#### 国产大模型

模型 | 开发方 | 链接 | 中文简介（关键能力与发布时间） 
---|---|---|---

DeepSeek-V3.2 / V3.2-Speciale | 深度求索 | 论文 | 2025 年 12 月发布，引入 DSA 稀疏注意力，正式版比肩 GPT-5；Speciale 在 IMO / IOI / ICPC 2025 达金牌水平。 
DeepSeek-V3.1 / V3.1-Terminus | 深度求索 | HuggingFace | 2025 年 8–9 月，混合推理架构（思考 / 非思考双模式），面向 Agent 工具调用优化。 
DeepSeek-V3 | 深度求索 | GitHub | 2024 年 12 月发布，671B/37B 激活 MoE，以极高性价比对标 GPT-4 级别。 
DeepSeek-R1 | 深度求索 | GitHub | 2025 年 1 月发布的开源推理模型，比肩 o1，掀起全球开源推理浪潮；5 月 R1-0528 升级版。 
DeepSeekMath-V2 / OCR-2 | 深度求索 | Math-V2 ・OCR-2 | 专项模型：Math-V2（2025-11）自我可验证数学推理达 IMO 金牌；OCR-2（2026-01）Visual Causal Flow 文档理解。 
Qwen3（通义千问 3） | 阿里巴巴 | GitHub | 2025 年 4 月发布，Apache 2.0 开源，0.6B–235B 多规格，首推混合推理，支持 119 种语言与 MCP。 
GLM-4.6 / GLM-4.5 | 智谱 AI | HuggingFace | GLM-4.5（2025 年 7 月）355B/32B MoE，MIT 协议开源，面向智能体；GLM-4.6 进一步升级。 
Kimi K3 | 月之暗面 | GitHub ・HuggingFace | 2026 年 7 月开放权重（Kimi K3 License）：2.8T 参数原生多模态 Agent 模型，KDA + AttnRes 新架构，896 专家激活 16 个，1M 上下文，主打长程编码与端到端知识工作；配套开源 RL 环境平台 AgentENV。 
Kimi K2 / K2 Thinking | 月之暗面 | GitHub | K2（2025 年 7 月）1T/32B MoE 开源；K2 Thinking（11 月）多项基准超 GPT-5、Sonnet 4.5。 
MiniMax M2 | MiniMax | GitHub | 2025 年 10 月发布的开源大模型，主打高效推理与智能体能力。 
ERNIE 4.5 / 文心一言 | 百度 | yiyan.baidu.com | 2025 年 3 月发布，MoE 架构最高 424B/47B；配套 ERNIE X1 深度推理模型。 
混元（Hunyuan / T1） | 腾讯 | hunyuan.tencent.com | 腾讯自研大模型家族，T1 推理模型开放使用，覆盖文本与多模态。 
豆包（Doubao） | 字节跳动 | doubao.com | 字节 C 端 AI 应用，月活领先，背后为字节自研大模型矩阵。 

#### 评测榜单与资源

资源 | 链接 | 中文简介 
---|---|---
LMArena（原 Chatbot Arena） | lmarena.ai | 众包匿名对战 + Elo 评分的权威 LLM 排行榜，业界最受认可的横向对比之一。 
Open LLM Leaderboard | HuggingFace | 基于标准化基准的开源模型自动评测榜单，适合硬指标对比。 
SuperCLUE | superclueai.com | 中文通用大模型综合性测评基准，中文场景的主流权威榜单。 
Artificial Analysis | artificialanalysis.ai | 第三方独立评测，汇总智能指数、速度、价格等维度，便于按性价比选型。 
中文大模型能力评测榜单 | chinese-llm-benchmark | 持续更新的中文大模型能力评测，覆盖国内外主流闭源与开源模型，含客观题与主观题多维度打分，适合中文场景选型参考。 
Models.dev | models.dev / GitHub | SST 团队开源的 AI 模型数据库，收录各家模型的上下文窗口、输出上限、价格、能力（推理/工具调用/结构化输出）与开闭源信息；提供免费 JSON API（models.dev/api.json），是 opencode 等开源项目的模型数据源，数据以 TOML 文件社区共建。 

### 早期经典开源 LLM（历史存档）

以下为 2023 年前后的开源模型，多数已被新版取代，保留供学习与参考。

### 大模型

名称 | Stars | 简介 | 备注 
---|---|---|---
grok-1 | Grok open release. | 马斯克 X 开源大模型 
Mistral-7B | Reference implementation of Mistral AI 7B v0.1 model. | Mistral-7B 开源模型，性能评价不错 
Alpaca | Code and documentation to train Stanford's Alpaca models, and generate the data. | - 
WizardLM | Family of instruction-following LLMs powered by Evol-Instruct: WizardLM, WizardCoder and WizardMath. | 数学能力与 ChatGPT 相差无几的开源大模型

dolly | Databricks’ Dolly, a large language model trained on the Databricks Machine Learning Platform | Databricks 发布的 Dolly 2.0 大语言模型。业内第一个开源、遵循指令的 LLM，它在透明且免费提供的数据集上进行了微调，该数据集也是开源的，可用于商业目的。这意味着 Dolly 2.0 可用于构建商业应用程序，无需支付 API 访问费用或与第三方共享数据。 
Falcon 40B | Falcon-40B-Instruct is a 40B parameters causal decoder-only model built by TII based on Falcon-40B and finetuned on a mixture of Baize. It is made available under the Apache 2.0 license. | - 
FastChat (Vicuna) | An open platform for training, serving, and evaluating large language models. Release repo for Vicuna and FastChat-T5. | 继草泥马（Alpaca）后，斯坦福联手CMU、UC伯克利等机构的学者再次发布了130亿参数模型骆马（Vicuna），仅需300美元就能实现ChatGPT 90%的性能。 
GLM-130B (ChatGLM) | An Open Bilingual Pre-Trained Model (ICLR 2023) 
GPT-NeoX | An implementation of model parallel autoregressive transformers on GPUs, based on the DeepSpeed library.

# Latest Frontier Model Support and More in Releases 2026.21/22

4 min read

Written by Nhu Ho November 11, 2026

Releases 2026.21 and 2026.22 bring the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral AI to Cognigy and give you more flexibility with Amazon Polly TTS voice engines.

## Newest OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral AI Models

You can now build with state-of-the-art models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral AI in Cognigy, and choose the best one for each use case.

OpenAI and Microsoft Azure OpenAI

- gpt-6-sol and gpt-6.1-sol: complex tasks, such as coding.
- gpt-6-luna: lower-cost model for high-volume tasks with a clear goal, such as extracting information or answering quick questions.

Anthropic

- claude-opus-5-5: complex work that requires careful judgment.
- claude-sonnet-5-5: well-scoped everyday tasks that need fast output.
- claude-haiku-5-5: high-volume, cost-sensitive applications.

- ministral-14b-latest: higher accuracy at a low cost.
- ministral-8b-latest: compact model with a strong performance-to-cost ratio.
- ministral-3b-latest: fast, lightweight tasks.

Using larger models only where the task demands it keeps quality high where it counts and lowers cost and latency everywhere else.

## Amazon Polly TTS Engine Selection in Voice Gateway

Voice Gateway now lets you choose between the Generative, Neural, and Standard Amazon Polly engines, with a separate engine for the fallback speech vendor.

That gives you direct control over how your voice AI Agents sound and what they cost: Generative for the most expressive, human-like speech when voice quality comes first, Neural for natural-sounding speech at a lower cost, and Standard for basic speech at the lowest cost.

### Other Improvements

#### Cognigy

- Reduced NLU model loading time during intent scoring, helping AI Agents respond faster when many users interact with them simultaneously
- Renamed Salesforce Messaging for In-App and Web (MIAW) to Salesforce Enhanced Chat in the UI to match the current Salesforce product name
- Added the Custom URL field in the LLM editor for Mistral AI models
- Added the A2A Agent Node as a child Node of the LLM Prompt Node, making it easier to use A2A capabilities within LLM-based workflows
- Added API Key to the Performed By column and filter on the Audit Events page to make changes made through the Cognigy API easier to track
- Improved service security and stability

#### Cognigy Agent Copilot

- Added the End Session On Handover Close toggle and the Session TTL On Handover Close field to the Copilot section of the Endpoint settings. This improvement lets human agents trigger follow-up actions in the Agent Copilot Flow after resolving a conversation without keeping it open
- Added the Enable Branding toggle to the Copilot section of the Endpoint settings. This toggle lets you remove the Powered by Cognigy.AI branding to better align the Agent Copilot workspace with your organization’s branding

#### Cognigy Live Agent

- Improved service security, stability and performance

For further information, check out our complete Release Notes.

cross_cutting.content:
Engineering & Research

# ZoomGain-4B Shipped on November 11 With No Announcement Behind It

Latest models · 20View all models →

Benchmarks: Artificial Analysis · updated daily

Back to all posts

The first commit in inclusionAI/ZoomGain is stamped 2026-11-09 at 02:13 UTC and its message is "Release ZoomGain init." The weights for ZoomGain-4B appeared on Hugging Face on 2026-11-10 at 11:38 UTC. The arXiv listing, the evaluation set and the reinforcement-learning corpus that produced it are all dated 2026-11-11, the same day the model card was last touched. What has not appeared, anywhere I could find, is a launch post. There is no news entry on inclusionAI's site, no announcement on the organisation's Hugging Face profile beyond the repository itself, no hosted endpoint, and no coverage from anyone. ZoomGain-4B is a vision-language model built by reinforcement learning on top of Qwen3.5-4B, and as of this morning the only people who know it exists are the ones who happened to look at a repository listing. This is a what-the-repo-says article: every figure below is either a timestamp you can verify yourself or a number the authors put on their own card, and the places where that is not enough are marked as such.

For a reader who wants the shape of it before the detail: the model is a 4.54-billion-parameter multimodal checkpoint that answers multiple-choice questions about fine visual detail — small text in a photograph, an object count in a cluttered scene, an attribute that is only legible when you crop in. The authors' claim is that a vision model looking at a full image misses details it can read perfectly well once the same region is zoomed, and that this gap can be turned into training signal. They then built a 1,000-question benchmark out of the same machinery, and on that benchmark the trained 4B scores 55.81 against 30.03 for the model it was trained from. Those two numbers are the whole case, and they come with a caveat that the paper states itself: the benchmark is built by the same pipeline as the training data, which the paper calls "held-in".

## What landed, and what the timestamps say

The release is unusually complete for something nobody announced. Six artefacts, all within a 48-hour window:

• The paper. "ZoomGain: Mining Global-to-Zoom Perception Gaps for Fine-Grained Visual Supervision," arXiv 2611.14076, submitted 10 November 2026, by Haozhan Shen, Liangbo He, Jun Lan, Huijia Zhu, Weiqiang Wang, Tiancheng Zhao and Jianwei Yin. Seven authors, cs.CV and cs.AI.

• The 4B checkpoint. inclusionAI/ZoomGain-4B, safetensors in BF16. The file metadata counts 4,539,265,536 parameters. Apache 2.0 on the code; the card defers checkpoint and dataset terms to their own repositories.

• The 9B checkpoint. inclusionAI/ZoomGain-9B, 9,409,813,744 parameters, created four minutes after its smaller sibling.

• Quantised builds. ZoomGain-4B-GGUF landed on 2026-11-11 at 03:09 UTC with three precisions plus matching vision projectors: Q4_K_M at 2.71 GB, Q8_0 at 4.48 GB, F16 at 8.42 GB, each with an mmproj file for the image encoder. The 9B GGUF followed.

• The benchmark. inclusionAI/ZoomGainBench, 1,000 questions over 941 images, English and Chinese text for every item, plus a reference answer, a scoring rule and an evidence bounding box in pixel coordinates.

• The training data. inclusionAI/ZoomGain-RL-Data, 9,000 records and 7,713 source images in Parquet, with the reward metadata the training script expects.

The quietness is not a mystery and it is not sinister. It is what a research group's internal release looks like when the paper clears arXiv before anyone writes the blog post. The tells are all there: three commits on the morning of 11 November are all titled "update readme" fourteen minutes apart, the GitHub repository has three stars and no description field filled in, both checkpoint repositories show zero downloads and zero likes, and the 4B model page carries a warning about empty or missing YAML metadata. None of that is evidence about the model. It is evidence about the rollout.

## The method, in three moves

The interesting part of ZoomGain is not the model, it is how the questions were made. The pipeline runs in three stages and only the first one is conventional.

• Ground the target. Several models independently locate a region described in the full scene. Where they agree, that agreement is taken as the crop worth keeping. Using disagreement as a filter means no single model's blind spot defines the target set.

• Mine evidence. Captions of the same region are compared at two zoom levels. Whatever the crop reveals and the full image does not is turned into a question about the full image. This is the mechanism that produces the "global-to-zoom" gap the title refers to: the question is answerable, but only if the model resolves something at the edge of its perception.

• Verify and distract. Answers are cross-checked against the crop, ambiguous questions are dropped, questions that can be answered without the image at all are dropped, and multiple-choice distractors are generated. The ablation says this last step is doing real work — removing dedicated distractors costs 8.96 points on the held-in benchmark, the largest single drop the paper reports.

Training itself is not exotic. GRPO through the bundled EasyR1 framework, one epoch, batch size 64, eight rollouts per question, which works out to 140 steps on 9,000 records. The repository ships a smoke test that runs a single step including rollout, reward and checkpoint save, and full launchers for both sizes. PyTorch 2.10, FlashAttention 2.8.3, vLLM 0.19.1 and transformers 5.7.0 — all pinned, which is the difference between a repository that reproduces and one that merely describes.

## The number that matters, and the caveat that shrinks it

ZoomGainBench is deliberately hard. The strongest model on it is GPT-5.6-Sol at 61.08 overall, and that is 61.08 out of 100 on multiple-choice questions about photographs. Claude-Opus-5 sits at 59.86, Gemini-3.6-Flash at 59.41. The best open general vision model in the table, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next at 125 billion parameters, reaches 55.05. A 4-billion-parameter model trained on 9,000 samples lands at 55.81 — above the 125B generalist, above Kimi-K3 at 2.8 trillion parameters, above GLM-5.3-Flash at 320 billion.

If that number survived contact with an independent harness it would be the story of the month. It does not, yet, for a reason the paper is upfront about. ZoomGainBench is constructed by the same pipeline that produced the training data, and the paper's own ablation table lists it under a column headed "Held-in." The questions are not the training questions, but they are drawn from the same distribution by the same machinery. A model fine-tuned on that distribution has an advantage that a model evaluated zero-shot does not, and the size of the advantage is exactly what nobody outside inclusionAI can measure today.

The held-out evidence is less spectacular and more convincing. The paper reports an average over ten held-out benchmarks: 54.20 for the untrained Qwen3.5-4B, 60.96 for the ZoomGain-trained 4B. A 6.76-point average gain on benchmarks the training never saw is a real result. It is just not the same claim as beating a 2.8-trillion-parameter model.

Worth noting too that the win is not uniform. Comparing the 4B against its own base across the paper's main

# ZoomGain-9B Shipped Without an Announcement: What the Repository Actually Says

Latest models · 20View all models →

Benchmarks: Artificial Analysis · updated daily

Back to all posts

The paper went up on arXiv on 10 November 2026. The GitHub repository was created a day earlier, on 9 November, and its first commit is titled "Release ZoomGain init". The weights appeared on Hugging Face on 10 November at 11:42 UTC, followed by a GGUF repository on 11 November at 03:16. There is no launch blog post, no vendor announcement, no hosted endpoint, and no licence tag on the checkpoint repository itself. That is the entire public record for ZoomGain-9B, a 9.4-billion-parameter vision-language model from inclusionAI, the open-model arm of Ant Group, and the reason this piece is written as a repository reading rather than a launch story.

What makes it worth the attention is not the stealth. It is that the repository is unusually complete for something nobody announced: the paper, the 1,000-question benchmark, the 9,000-record reinforcement-learning dataset, the evaluator, the training launcher, two checkpoints at 4B and 9B, and three GGUF quantisations all landed inside roughly two days. You can read the method, re-run the evaluation and reproduce the training today. The only thing missing is someone from the company saying it exists.

## What actually landed, in order

• 9 November 2026 — the inclusionAI GitHub repository is created. It carries the Apache 2.0 licence and the data-construction and training code, not the weights.

• 10 November 2026 — arXiv:2611.14076v1, "ZoomGain: Mining Global-to-Zoom Perception Gaps for Fine-Grained Visual Supervision", by Haozhan Shen, Liangbo He, Jun Lan, Huijia Zhu, Weiqiang Wang, Tiancheng Zhao and Jianwei Yin, with affiliations at Ant Group, Zhejiang University, Om AI Research and the Binjiang Institute.

• 10 November 2026, 11:42 UTC — inclusionAI/ZoomGain-9B and inclusionAI/ZoomGain-4B are created on the Hub, each with a single 18.82 GB and 9.08 GB BF16 safetensors file respectively.

• 11 November 2026, 03:16 UTC — inclusionAI/ZoomGain-9B-GGUF appears with Q4_K_M, Q8_0 and F16 builds plus matching mmproj projector files, which is the step that turns a research checkpoint into something a laptop can attempt.

A small detail worth noting because it is exactly the kind of thing a coordinated launch does not produce: the model card's own "Updates" section dates the paper, the benchmark, the dataset and the checkpoints all as 2026.11.11, while the repository's creation timestamp and the arXiv submission date both say 10 November. The card was written after the fact, in one pass, by someone tidying up.

## The idea, in one paragraph, because it is genuinely one idea

A vision model can often answer a question about a region of an image that it fails when the same region appears inside the whole frame. The authors call this the global-to-zoom perception gap, and they turn it into supervision. Stage one: several models independently locate a target described in the full scene, and their agreement identifies a region to crop. Stage two: captions of the crop and captions of the full scene are compared, and any detail that the crop reveals but the full view does not becomes a question asked about the original image. Stage three: answers are re-checked on the crop, ambiguous questions and questions answerable from language priors are filtered out, and plausible distractors are generated for the multiple-choice format.

Training is GRPO on 9,000 records built over 7,713 source images — one epoch, batch size 64, eight rollouts per question — using the bundled EasyR1 code. Evaluation defaults to temperature 0 with Qwen3.5 thinking disabled, and OCR and counting questions stay open-ended while attribute questions become multiple choice. None of that is unusual in itself; what is unusual is that the pipeline that generated the training data also generated the benchmark, and the paper is explicit about it.

## Two numbers that are not the same number

On ZoomGainBench — the 1,000-question, 941-image, English-and-Chinese benchmark built by this same pipeline — ZoomGain-9B scores 55.48. Its base model, Qwen3.5-9B, scores 32.13. That is a 23.35-point jump on a benchmark the model's own training data was mined from, and the paper labels the column "Held-in" for precisely that reason.

The number to carry into a decision is the average over thirteen benchmarks the training never touched, which excludes ZoomGainBench: 66.10 for ZoomGain-9B against 59.75 for Qwen3.5-9B. A 6.35-point average gain from 9,000 samples is a solid, believable result. Both numbers are real. They answer different questions, and any page that quotes 55.48 without saying "held-in" is telling you half of it.

There is a second oddity in the same table that nobody seems to have noticed yet: the smaller sibling beats the 9B on the held-in benchmark. ZoomGain-4B scores 55.81 on ZoomGainBench against the 9B's 55.48, while losing the held-out average 63.96 to 66.10. On the benchmark built from the training distribution the two are level within noise; once you leave that distribution, size reasserts itself. If you were choosing between them on the strength of a single headline number, you would pick the wrong one.
# ZoomGain-9B — the scoreboard
HR-Bench 4K:

90.25

V*Bench:

93.19

VisualProbe:

56.31

ZoomGainBench (held-in):

55.48

Held-out average:

66.10

MMStar:

73.87

1️⃣ All figures author-reported on the released harness; not independently reproduced.

## What 9,000 samples bought, benchmark by benchmark

All of the following are author-reported figures from Table 3 of the paper, run by the authors' own harness on the released evaluator, and not independently reproduced by anyone:

• HR-Bench 4K — 90.25, up from 82.13. This is the number the abstract leads with, and it is the strongest claim in the release.

• V*Bench — 93.19, up from 86.91. Small-object detection at high resolution.

• VisualProbe — 56.31, up from 44.66. The largest relative gain outside the held-in benchmark.

• O3-Bench — 68.12, up from 56.52. Multi-step perception and reasoning.

• MMVP — 70.00, up from 60.00. The classic test of paired images that differ in one detail.

• MMStar — 73.87, up from 71.73. General multimodal competence, and the smallest gain of the set.

• BabyVision — 17.53, up from 15.98. Still near the floor, and a useful reminder that the gains are concentrated in the fine-detail family rather than spread evenly.

Read together, the pattern is consistent with the method rather than with a general capability bump: the biggest deltas sit on benchmarks that reward finding a small thing in a large frame, and the smallest sit on benchmarks that reward broad world knowledge and ordinary visual reasoning. That is what a targeted RL run on 9,000 cropped-detail questions should look like.

## What is knowable, what is claimed, and what is simply not confirmed

Knowable from the repository, today, without taking anyone's word for it: the architecture, because the config is public and identifies a Qwen3.5-9B text trunk at 32 layers, hidden size 4,096, intermediate 12,288 and 262,144 maximum positions, wrapped in a vision tower; the training data, because the 9,000-record Parquet and the source images ship as a dataset; the method, because the prompts are in the paper's appendix; and the evaluation, because the evaluator, the annotations and the images are all downloadable.

Claimed but not confirmed: every benchmark score above. The paper reports them on the released harness, which makes them more checkable than most vendor tables — you can re-run them — but nobody outside the author list has done so yet, and no independent lab has published a ZoomGain-9B result.

Not confirmed at all, and worth being blunt about:

• The checkpoint licence. The code is Apache 2.0 and the card says so. The card then defers the model and dataset terms to "the Hugging Face cards for the terms of each dataset and checkpoint", and the checkpoint repository carries no licence tag in its Hub metadata. That is a gap to close by reading the files before you ship, not a promise you can rely on.

• The context length. The card states none. The config's 262,144 maximum positions are inherited from the Qwen3.5-9B trunk, which is not the same as a tested property of the post-trained checkpoint, and every evaluation in the paper is a single image with thinking disabled.

• General assistant behaviour. Nothing in the release tests chat, tool calling, long-form generation or multi-turn use. The model was trained to answer questions about photographs, and that is the only capability with evidence behind it.

• Any host. The Hub's provider mapping for the repository is empty. There is no vendor API and no third-party endpoint listed, so "try it" currently means "download 18.82 GB".

## Running it this week, if you want to

The GGUF path is the cheap one: a 5.63 GB Q4_K_M build plus a 0.52 GB mmproj projector, or 9.53 GB at Q8_0, or 17.92 GB at F16. Image input needs both files — the projector is not optional, and a llama.cpp build with Qwen3.5 multimodal support is the prerequisite. The reference path is heavier but better documented: vLLM 0.19.1 with transformers 5.7.0, exactly the versions the authors evaluated with, on a BF16 checkpoint that wants a 24 GB card at minimum and comfortable headroom above that.

Worth budgeting for the evaluation protocol as well as the weights. The authors run at temperature 0 with thinking disabled and score attribute questions by exact match on the chosen option, counting by exact match on the predicted integer, and OCR by ANLS with a 0.7 floor. If you evaluate with thinking on, or with a different prompt template, you are measuring something the authors did not report and should not expect their number

cross_cutting.content:
Webinar

# How Salesforce uses AI agents and humans together to solve complex cases

Service Cloud

What does it really take to bring an AI agent to your customers in weeks, not months? And what happens if a case needs a human touch?

Join us for a behind-the-scenes look at how Salesforce launched an AI agent on Salesforce Help in just three weeks, and our plans to scale across even more support channels. Learn how we’ve been resolving the most complex cases autonomously, and how the system hands off with full context right in Service Cloud if a human rep is needed.

You’ll walk away with 3 key learnings:

- Deploy in weeks, not months: What it really takes to get an AI agent live quickly, even when you’re building on an existing experience.
- Build the right team from day one: The roles, skills, and team structure needed to launch and operate agentic customer service successfully.
- Resolve even the most complex cases faster: How the best AI agents aren’t just simple answer retrieval. They connect into your systems, take action, and resolve autonomously – so your human reps can focus on the higher value problems.

Bring your questions about planning, deploying, and running an AI agent alongside your service team.
